blocks.text: In celebration of his 75th birthday, OPM icon Basil Valdez is set to stage the “Salamin ng Buhay,” a concert featuring his classic hits from his decades-long music career. The special concert, set for two shows on Nov. 14 and 21, serves as Valdez’s “own tribute to a most remarkable life of song that he has lived so far.” Valdez, whose classics include “Ngayon at Kailanman,” “Nais Ko,” “You,” “Gaano Kadalas ang Minsan” and “Kastilyong Buhangin,” will share the stage with guest performers including Ryan Cayabyab Singers on Nov. 14, and the Ateneo Chamber Singers on Nov. 21.
